meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call

examples.text: У неё есть счёт в банке.

examples.trans: The bank closes at six o'clock.

examples.text: Или счёт в банке. Потому что они все обманщики.
examples.trans: Or a bank account. Because they are all cheats.

examples.text: Теперь разрешите пригласить вас в баню.
examples.trans: Now allow me to invite you to the bathhouse.
It is a genuine, good Russian bathhouse.

examples.text: Да, русскую баню я очень люблю!
examples.trans: Yes, I love a Russian bathhouse very much!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('white').

examples.trans: The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: Prefix 'вз-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'бивать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to whip, to beat', paired with 'взбить'.

examples.trans: Louis, I finished whipping the cream.

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'дяной'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('water (attributive), aquatic').

examples.text: И разогреть шоколад на водяной бане.
examples.trans: And melt the chocolate in a water bath.

meanings.note: ends a conversation or an order: 'Всё, свободен' = that's all, you can go
at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.en: to add, supplement, put in as an addition

examples.text: Я добавляю свежую зелень и соус.
examples.trans: I add fresh greens and sauce.

examples.text: Макс, быстрее! Уже пора добавлять яйца.
examples.trans: Max, faster! It is time to add the eggs.
Add the dye slowly and carefully.

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.
examples.trans: I was wrong. Forgive me. I want to finish what I started.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Core Russian conj meaning 'or' in everyday speech.
Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'чезнуть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to disappear, to vanish', paired with 'исчезать'.

examples.trans: Where did my knife disappear to?

examples.text: Это слово «исчезнуть» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'to disappear' is often heard in conversation.

examples.text: В тесте не должно быть комочков.
examples.trans: There should be no lumps in the batter.
Stir evenly, so there are no lumps.

examples.text: Кондитер взбил нежный крем для торта.
examples.trans: The pastry chef whipped delicate cream for the cake.

examples.text: Сколько ложек коньяка добавить в крем?
examples.trans: How many spoonfuls of cognac to add to the cream?
Louis, I finished whipping the cream.

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Wait, where are you two going?
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
And the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'logo' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: White chocolate for the bank logo.
Only white, for the bank logo!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('favourite, beloved').

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой! До вечера, Марина.
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake! See you tonight, Marina.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'чинка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'filling, stuffing' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I am making the filling for the cake.
Usually I make the filling right away.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
end-stressed in all oblique forms: ножа, ножом

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!
There is a sharp knife on the table.

examples.text: Нина, ну как ты могла? Живого человека ножом резать!
examples.trans: Nina, how could you? Cutting a living person with a knife!

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ычно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: А в каких местах он обычно пьёт?
examples.trans: And in what places does he usually drink?

examples.text: Он обычно встаёт в семь утра.
examples.trans: He usually gets up at seven in the morning.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'личный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('excellent').

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.
All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

постоять.gloss: to stand for a while; to wait

examples.trans: I'll stand here for a bit.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: Stir evenly, so there are no lumps.

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'огреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to warm up, to melt', paired with 'разогревать'.

examples.trans: The chocolate needs to be melted.
How much chocolate needs to be melted?

examples.text: И разогреть шоколад на водяной бане.
examples.trans: And melt the chocolate in a water bath.
Before you is a unique ancient recipe.

examples.text: Шеф хранит этот секретный рецепт в тайне.
examples.trans: The chef keeps this secret recipe confidential.

examples.text: Шеф хранит свой тайный рецепт супа.
examples.trans: The chef keeps his secret soup recipe.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Секунду! = One second! / Just a moment!

examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.
One second. I'll call Mishkin right now.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'разу').

examples.trans: You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.text: Всё, хорошо, я тебя выпущу! Только собаку не трогай!
examples.trans: All right, fine, I'll let you out! Just don't touch the dog!

examples.text: Он надел тёмные очки в солнечный день.
examples.trans: He put on dark glasses on a sunny day.

examples.text: На нём были большие тёмные очки.
examples.trans: He was wearing large dark glasses.

examples.text: Он просто наденет тёмные чёрные очки.
examples.trans: He will simply put on dark black glasses.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

examples.text: Всё, ты в шоколаде, проблем больше нет!
examples.trans: That is it, you are golden, there are no more problems!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
